Buddhi sach ki bijli ki chamak hai.

Tez dimaag devtaon ka sabse accha tohfa hai.
Ahankari manushya bina patwaar ka jahaj hai.
Buddhi dar se zang laga hua disha suchak hai.

Ek chatur shabd toofaan me prakash stambh hai.

Buddhi devtaon ki hansi hai.
Teekhi baat buddhi ki talwar hai.

Jeevan ek natak hai; apana kirdar achhe se nibhao.
Yatra ek akele kadam se shuru ho.
Buddhi kadve imtihaanon ka meetha phal hai.
Buddhi jeevant dimaag ki saans hai.
Rooh apni har haari hui ladai yaad rakhti hai.

Ahankari dil vastavikta se takra kar toot ta hai.
